What have we proved? A working software loop from a shared case to an adjustment amount and location, then a revised action from a new observation. We have not proved physical performance or future-batch consistency. Simpler baselines matched the arithmetic, and a parser matched note extraction faster. ReMatter connects engineering proposals, checked calculations and a clear next action. Retention, durability and tipping safety still need their own tests.
